cues.en: Hi, and welcome to this AI and C-Sharp video on the Microsoft Agent Framework.
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎收看這支介紹 Microsoft Agent Framework 的 C# AI 影片。

cues.en: Today we're going to dive into a topic that has changed a lot during the RC1 and RC2 releases of Microsoft Agent Framework,
cues.zh: 今天要深入介紹一個在 Microsoft Agent Framework RC1 與 RC2 期間有重大變更的主題，

cues.en: and that is the AI Contact Provider, or AI Contact Providers in plural now, because we have the option to have multiple of them.
cues.zh: 就是 AI Context Provider；現在也可以說 Providers，因為已經能同時使用多個。

cues.en: But it has completely changed since the preview, so in this video, we're going to do a really, really deep dive
cues.zh: 它和預覽版相比已經完全不同，所以這支影片會深入介紹，

cues.en: on what it can do, what is all the methods you can override, why are they there, and so on,
cues.zh: 它能做什麼、有哪些方法可以覆寫，以及這些方法存在的原因，

cues.en: in order for you to better understand everything here.
cues.zh: 幫助你完整理解這個機制。

cues.en: So in the samples, I have an AI Contact Providers deep dive.
cues.zh: 範例中有一個 AI Context Providers Deep Dive。

cues.en: I've made a folder for this, and I've taken my two previous videos, one on how to do memory, and one on how to do on-the-fly tool calling,
cues.zh: 我為此建立了資料夾，並把之前介紹記憶，以及動態加入工具的兩支影片範例，

cues.en: and put them up in here because they're all three using the AI Contact Provider.
cues.zh: 也移到這裡，因為這三個範例都使用 AI Context Provider。

cues.en: So I'm going to primarily work here, and then I will show you how these have changed a bit as we go along.
cues.zh: 主要會在這裡示範，再順便說明另外兩個範例有哪些變更。

cues.en: But what I have is a completely normal agent here, and right now, I have no Contact Providers.
cues.zh: 這裡有一個很普通的代理程式，目前沒有任何 Context Provider。

cues.en: Before we got the RC1, this was called AI Contact Provider Factory,
cues.zh: 在 RC1 之前，這個設定稱為 AIContextProviderFactory，

cues.en: and we can only give one option, and we needed to inject a bunch of odd things.
cues.zh: 只能提供一個選項，還得注入一些比較奇怪的東西。

cues.en: But now, it's just that we can view our classes.
cues.zh: 現在則只要提供我們的類別。

cues.en: But let's quickly run without, just for you to see what it is I'm running here.
cues.zh: 先不加任何提供者執行一次，看看這個範例在做什麼。

cues.en: So I have a completely normal chat loop, and if I say hi,
cues.zh: 這就是一般的對話迴圈；如果我說你好，

cues.en: I'm printing out the raw HTML, or the LLM call directly, so we can also see what is going on.
cues.zh: 它會印出原始 HTTP，也就是實際送給 LLM 的呼叫，方便觀察。

cues.en: So when I say hi, the LLM call happens, the system message is being added because I put a system message here, saying we need to wave in the prefix,
cues.zh: 說你好時，就會發出 LLM 呼叫；因為我設定了系統指示，要求回覆前先加揮手圖示，所以會加入系統訊息，

cues.en: the user message sent, and the final response is here.
cues.zh: 再送出使用者訊息，最後得到這裡的回覆。

cues.en: So this is pretty normal, other than I put in that we can actually see what the LLM request is.
cues.zh: 除了額外印出 LLM 請求之外，都是很一般的流程。

cues.en: So now let's put in our AI Contact Provider.
cues.zh: 接著加入 AI Context Provider。

cues.en: And an AI Contact Provider is just a class that inherits from AI Contact Provider.
cues.zh: AI Context Provider 就是一個繼承 AIContextProvider 的類別。

cues.en: And it has four methods you can overwrite.
cues.zh: 其中有四個可以覆寫的方法。

cues.en: Invoking call, provideAIContext, invoke call, and storeAIContext.
cues.zh: 分別是 InvokingCoreAsync、ProvideAIContextAsync、InvokedCoreAsync，以及 StoreAIContextAsync。

cues.en: And the order they are called in is that the invoking call actually is in charge of calling the provideAIContext,
cues.zh: 呼叫順序是 InvokingCoreAsync 先負責呼叫 ProvideAIContextAsync，

cues.en: then the LLM call happens, and then the invoked happen, and store.
cues.zh: 接著執行 LLM 呼叫，之後執行 InvokedCoreAsync，再呼叫 StoreAIContextAsync。

cues.en: So in real life, there are four of these, theoretically, but when you are going to use these,
cues.zh: 因此理論上有四個方法，但實際使用時，

cues.en: you will essentially never use the invoking and the invoked.
cues.zh: 幾乎不需要自己處理 Invoking 與 Invoked。

cues.en: Behind the scenes, these two have some very, very advanced things of merging messages, because there can be multiple of these.
cues.zh: 它們內部有非常進階的訊息合併邏輯，因為同時可能有多個提供者。

cues.en: But in reality, you will stay here.
cues.zh: 一般情況下，只需要專注這兩個方法。

cues.en: This is the user version, while this is a more technical version.
cues.zh: 這是給一般使用者覆寫的版本，另外兩個則偏底層技術。

cues.en: And I will argue that if you know when to use this, you probably don't need this video.
cues.zh: 如果你已經知道什麼時候該覆寫底層方法，大概就不需要這支影片了。

cues.en: And in the same manner, if you were to use this, where you can go and overwrite how error handling works
cues.zh: 同樣地，如果需要自行覆寫錯誤處理，

cues.en: when something goes wrong in the LLM, you're probably not going to need this video.
cues.zh: 改變 LLM 發生錯誤時的行為，你大概也不需要這支影片。

cues.en: So we're going to focus on these two ones here.
cues.zh: 所以這裡會專注這兩個方法。

cues.en: ProvideAIContext, which happens before the LLM call, and storeAIContext, which happens after the LLM call.
cues.zh: ProvideAIContextAsync 在 LLM 呼叫前執行，StoreAIContextAsync 則在呼叫後執行。

cues.en: But you can see I put in messages here, so we can see they are all being called, and we'll see that in one second.
cues.zh: 我在這裡加入了輸出訊息，方便確認所有方法都會被呼叫，稍後就會看到。

cues.en: But what are we using this for?
cues.zh: 那我們能用它做什麼呢？

cues.en: Well, whenever an LLM call is about to happen, we can interject things using this method.
cues.zh: 每次即將呼叫 LLM 時，都可以透過這個方法介入，加入額外內容。

cues.en: And what we have here, let me set a breakpoint so we can try it out.
cues.zh: 先在這裡設中斷點，實際試一下。

cues.en: So if I say hi, you will actually see that the invoking callAsync, meaning this method up here, have already been called.
cues.zh: 如果我說你好，可以看到上方的 InvokingCoreAsync 已經先被呼叫了。

cues.en: But right now, I don't have any code in here other than the message.
cues.zh: 不過我目前只在裡面輸出訊息，沒有其他程式碼。

cues.en: And again, we're not going to use this.
cues.zh: 再次提醒，我們不打算使用這個底層方法。

cues.en: But in here, we get a context.
cues.zh: 在這裡，我們會取得一個 context。

cues.en: What is this context?
cues.zh: 這個 context 是什麼呢？

cues.en: The context contains our agent.
cues.zh: 其中包含我們的代理程式。

cues.en: So if we need to get the name of the agent, or the instructions of the agent, or something here, we can get it from the context.
cues.zh: 因此如果需要代理程式名稱、指示或其他相關資訊，都能從 context 取得。

cues.en: We can also get the session.
cues.zh: 也能取得 session。

cues.en: In my case, I put in session on this call.
cues.zh: 這次呼叫有傳入 session。

cues.en: If we didn't have a session, it would just be null.
cues.zh: 如果沒有傳入，這裡就會是 null。

cues.en: But we have, in this case, our session we could go in and work with.
cues.zh: 在這個範例中，我們可以取得並操作 session。

cues.en: And then we have AIContext.
cues.zh: 接著是 AIContext。

cues.en: And this is right now what we have in the instructions in the system, and what messages that has been sent,
cues.zh: 目前其中包含系統指示，以及已送入的訊息，

cues.en: meaning our simple message of hi.
cues.zh: 也就是這則簡單的「你好」。

cues.en: And then it shows which tools are available right now.
cues.zh: 另外會顯示目前有哪些工具可用。

cues.en: And we can see there's no tools.
cues.zh: 可以看到，這裡沒有工具。

cues.en: I'm not using tools in this sample.
cues.zh: 這個範例沒有使用工具。

cues.en: So what we can do is we can go in and inspect this data, of course.
cues.zh: 當然，我們可以先檢查這些資料。

cues.en: So that's nothing special here.
cues.zh: 這裡沒有什麼特別的處理。

cues.en: So we're just gonna do that.
cues.zh: 所以先這樣做。

cues.en: What we can do here is we can go in.
cues.zh: 接下來可以進一步修改內容。

cues.en: Let me restart the code so we can see it again here.
cues.zh: 先重新執行程式，再看一次。

cues.en: Let's say hi again.
cues.zh: 再說一次你好。

cues.en: So we gotta get in here, because what we can get out is the message itself.
cues.zh: 進入這個位置後，就能取得訊息本身。

cues.en: And now you can argue, what do we need this for?
cues.zh: 你可能會問，這到底有什麼用？

cues.en: Well, we can go in and inject additional instructions.
cues.zh: 我們可以注入額外指示，

cues.en: We can inject additional tools.
cues.zh: 注入額外工具，

cues.en: And we can technically inject additional messages.
cues.zh: 技術上也可以注入額外訊息。

cues.en: But if we do that, they will become part of the chat history.
cues.zh: 不過如果加入訊息，它們會成為對話歷程的一部分。

cues.en: Because if we see here, this only happens for the LM call this one time and nothing more.
cues.zh: 相較之下，這裡的指示只會影響這一次 LLM 呼叫。

cues.en: It's not like it's being appended directly to the instructions again and again and again.
cues.zh: 不會一次又一次地永久附加到原本的指示後面。

cues.en: So in my case, I'm injecting some new instructions.
cues.zh: 這個範例會注入一段新的指示：

cues.en: That is, speak like a pirate.
cues.zh: 請像海盜一樣說話。

cues.en: And that's what I'm sending back from provide AI context.
cues.zh: 這就是 ProvideAIContextAsync 回傳的內容。

cues.en: So the AI context I'm providing is speak like a pirate.
cues.zh: 我們提供的 AI Context，就是這句海盜口吻的指示。

cues.en: And if I run this, we can then see now that I was called with invoking and then provide.
cues.zh: 執行後可以看到，先呼叫 Invoking，再呼叫 Provide。

cues.en: And we saw we just read out the message.
cues.zh: 剛才也有讀出原本的訊息。

cues.en: Then we can see that the messages, the system, now have the prefix or messages with our waves,
cues.zh: 現在系統訊息中，除了原本要求前面加揮手圖示的指示，

cues.en: but also speak like a pirate. So on the fly, Agent Framework added this to the context.
cues.zh: 還多了海盜口吻。Agent Framework 在執行時把它加入了上下文。

cues.en: But it's not like if we say hi again,
cues.zh: 但如果再說一次你好，

cues.en: it only adds it one time.
cues.zh: 每次都只會加一次。

cues.en: It's not like it's saying speak like a pirate, speak like a pirate, speak like a pirate.
cues.zh: 不會變成「像海盜說話、像海盜說話、像海盜說話」一直累積。

cues.en: So it is taking the original instructions and appending what we put in for that one call.
cues.zh: 它會取原始指示，再附加這一次呼叫所提供的內容。

cues.en: And then if we set some more breakpoints down in invoke,
cues.zh: 接著，在下方的 Invoked 設幾個中斷點，

cues.en: which again we don't really want to use for anything, and our store, here we could go in and begin to store it.
cues.zh: 這個方法同樣通常不需要覆寫；再到 Store，這裡就能開始儲存資訊。

cues.en: So we could extract information from the response or deal with exceptions in a different way than the default, which is just drawing the exception.
cues.zh: 例如擷取回覆資訊，或改變例外處理方式；預設只是將例外拋出。

cues.en: So if we say hi again,
cues.zh: 再說一次你好，

cues.en: we can now see that invoked happened.
cues.zh: 可以看到 Invoked 已經執行了。

cues.en: And if we just go down and see that invoke will call store, we will be able to see that in context here.
cues.zh: 它接著會呼叫 Store；現在看看這裡的 context。

cues.en: We can get the agent and the session as before.
cues.zh: 一樣能取得代理程式與 session。

cues.en: We can check if there's any exceptions.
cues.zh: 也可以檢查是否發生例外。

cues.en: But else we can get the request messages, meaning what we have set, but only for that one call, not the entire message or chat history.
cues.zh: 另外能取得 RequestMessages，也就是這一次送出的訊息，不包含整段對話歷程。

cues.en: If we want that, we need to take that from the session.
cues.zh: 如果需要完整歷程，就必須從 session 取得。

cues.en: And we can also see the response message, which is what is about to go back to the user, but haven't been shown yet to the user,
cues.zh: 我們也能看到即將回傳給使用者、但尚未顯示的回覆訊息，

cues.en: meaning we are still in the middle of the run async right now.
cues.zh: 因為目前仍然在 RunAsync 的執行過程中。

cues.en: So if we look at that, we can see we got invoked call async, the store AI context.
cues.zh: 看看輸出，可以看到 InvokedCoreAsync，接著是 StoreAIContextAsync。

cues.en: There was no exception.
cues.zh: 這次沒有例外。

cues.en: There was a request message of hi, and a response message of advanced here, which is the final response down here.
cues.zh: 請求訊息是你好，回覆訊息就在這裡，也就是下方最後顯示的答案。

cues.en: So that is how one AI context works.
cues.zh: 這就是一個 AI Context Provider 的運作方式。

cues.en: And let's see a few of the examples I have used it for, for context on why we want to do this.
cues.zh: 接著看幾個實際例子，理解我們為什麼需要它。

cues.en: So over here in my memory system, we are putting in a contact provider of a custom context provider here,
cues.zh: 在這個記憶系統裡，我們加入自訂的 Context Provider，

cues.en: where we're sending in an agent and a user ID.
cues.zh: 並傳入代理程式與使用者 ID。

cues.en: And over here, we're just storing those and saving some user ID, which is our memory store.
cues.zh: 提供者會保留這些資訊，並根據使用者 ID 找到記憶儲存位置。

cues.en: That could have been a database, but right now it's just a text file.
cues.zh: 實際上可以使用資料庫，不過這裡只是文字檔。

cues.en: And then we're reading all existing memory.
cues.zh: 然後讀取既有記憶。

cues.en: Again, this is a previous video, so you can go and check that in more details.
cues.zh: 這是先前影片的範例，想了解細節可以回去看。

cues.en: But the main thing is that whenever we provide AI context, we are taking that user fax and putting it into the memory,
cues.zh: 重點是，每次執行 ProvideAIContextAsync，都會把使用者的已知資訊加入上下文，

cues.en: just like we put in Speak Like a Pi before.
cues.zh: 就像剛才加入海盜口吻的指示一樣。

cues.en: Now we're putting in, for example, if it knows my name, my favorite color, and stuff like that.
cues.zh: 例如已知的姓名、最喜歡的顏色等。

cues.en: And in the store AI context, in that case, we are actually taking the request message, and we are using an AI to figure out
cues.zh: 而在 StoreAIContextAsync 中，會取出請求訊息，使用 AI 判斷，

cues.en: what I have told the AI, my favorite color is blue, and so on,
cues.zh: 使用者告訴了模型哪些事情，例如最喜歡的顏色是藍色，

cues.en: and extract any memories I want to add or update or delete, and save them into the file.
cues.zh: 再擷取要新增、更新或刪除的記憶，儲存到檔案中。

cues.en: So we are essentially just doing a pre and a post, pre being put in the user fax, post being extract new user fax after the fact.
cues.zh: 基本上就是前處理與後處理：前面加入既有使用者資訊，後面再擷取新的資訊。

cues.en: So that is how we use it for memory.
cues.zh: 這就是記憶功能的用法。

cues.en: If we want to see how we use it for tools, it's in a similar manner.
cues.zh: 工具的用法也很類似。

cues.en: So down here we add on-the-fly tool injection.
cues.zh: 這裡加入動態工具注入。

cues.en: Again, we are putting in an agent because we want to use AI to do something about this.
cues.zh: 同樣傳入一個代理程式，因為要用 AI 進行判斷。

cues.en: And then when we are providing AI context, we are actually looking at the message before it goes to the real run async, and extracting, in this case,
cues.zh: 提供 AI Context 時，會在真正執行 RunAsync 之前先看訊息，判斷這次，

cues.en: do we need to use some time tools, some weather tools, or some file system tools, and we end up with a response.
cues.zh: 需要時間工具、天氣工具，還是檔案系統工具，再取得結果。

cues.en: And based on that response, we make a new context back on which tools we want to inject.
cues.zh: 根據結果，建立新的 context，決定要注入哪些工具。

cues.en: So if we need time tools, we inject some time tools, some file system tools, or some weather tools,
cues.zh: 需要時間工具就注入時間工具，或是加入檔案系統、天氣相關工具，

cues.en: and the injected instruction is just something for the file tools and how it needs to work.
cues.zh: 這裡額外注入的指示，則是說明檔案工具應該如何使用。

cues.en: So here we are on-the-fly putting in tools.
cues.zh: 所以這裡是在執行時動態加入工具。

cues.en: Again, there's a separate video on this with much more details, but essentially, again, it's just that before the LM call, we add more instruction and tools.
cues.zh: 這也有一支更詳細的獨立影片；基本上就是在 LLM 呼叫前加入更多指示與工具。

cues.en: In this case, we're not caring about after the fact.
cues.zh: 這個範例不需要處理呼叫後的事情。

cues.en: Here, it's just pre-we're-going-to-do-something.
cues.zh: 只需要呼叫前的處理。

cues.en: So it's a very, very open-ended system of doing this.
cues.zh: 因此這是一個非常開放、可以自由延伸的機制。

cues.en: In my case, over here in the basic, we're just injecting Speak Like a Pirate.
cues.zh: 回到最基本的範例，我們只注入海盜口吻。

cues.en: But what if we have multiple of these?
cues.zh: 但如果同時有多個提供者呢？

cues.en: So I have my context provider 2 here as well.
cues.zh: 這裡也有 MyContextProvider2。

cues.en: And it's almost the same thing, but it only says, instead of Speak Like a Pirate, it says, suffix response with three robots.
cues.zh: 內容幾乎相同，只是指示改成「回覆最後加上三個機器人圖示」。

cues.en: But else, it's exactly the same.
cues.zh: 其他地方完全一樣。

cues.en: Again, we're not storing any context, we're just reading it out.
cues.zh: 同樣不儲存任何 context，只把內容輸出查看。

cues.en: But again, we could have taken whatever the AI came back with and done something with it.
cues.zh: 不過也可以取得 AI 回覆，再做其他處理，

cues.en: Made a summary of what we have talked about so far, for example.
cues.zh: 例如替目前對話製作摘要。

cues.en: So if we run it with two...
cues.zh: 所以，現在用兩個提供者執行……

cues.en: and say hi again, we can see, let's take this away,
cues.zh: 再說一次你好，先把這個移開，

cues.en: that we call the first AI context provider, then we call our second context provider.
cues.zh: 就能看到先呼叫第一個 AI Context Provider，再呼叫第二個。

cues.en: They're getting exactly the same information.
cues.zh: 它們取得完全相同的資訊。

cues.en: And they provide each one some data,
cues.zh: 各自提供自己的內容，

cues.en: Speak Like a Pirate, and put in suffix with the robots.
cues.zh: 一個要求海盜口吻，一個要求結尾加上機器人圖示。

cues.en: And that is all being put into the system message.
cues.zh: 最後都會被加入系統訊息。

cues.en: We have the original, we have the Speak Like a Pirate, and we have the suffix.
cues.zh: 這裡有原本的指示、海盜口吻，以及結尾圖示的要求。

cues.en: Beyond that, nothing else has changed in DLLM.
cues.zh: 除此之外，LLM 的請求沒有其他變更。

cues.en: And we get our messages back, and now we have that we have instructed it to get the robots at the end.
cues.zh: 回覆取回後，就能看到結尾有要求的機器人圖示。

cues.en: So we can put in as many of these as we wish to in order to do memory, tool injection, whatever we want to do.
cues.zh: 因此可以加入任意數量的提供者，處理記憶、工具注入或其他需求。

cues.en: And we can reuse these across multiple agents, so if we wanted for some reason to have the wave thing every time,
cues.zh: 這些提供者也可以跨代理程式重複使用；例如每次都想要求先揮手，

cues.en: we would just have a wave before you answer IA context provider.
cues.zh: 就建立一個「回覆前先揮手」的 AI Context Provider。

cues.en: There's also a third type of context provider, and it's called a message context provider.
cues.zh: 還有第三種提供者，稱為 Message Context Provider。

cues.en: So instead of AI context provider here, we have a message context provider.
cues.zh: 這裡不是繼承 AIContextProvider，而是 MessageContextProvider。

cues.en: This one is a bit strange compared to the other one in that it has both a provide AI context and a provide messages.
cues.zh: 它和前面的版本有點不同，同時有 ProvideAIContext 與 ProvideMessages。

cues.en: This one can actually provide messages, but they are permanently messages.
cues.zh: 前面提到的訊息注入，可能會讓訊息永久加入對話歷程。

cues.en: This one is on the fly extra messages you want to put into the system.
cues.zh: 這個版本則是用來加入這次呼叫所需的額外訊息。

cues.en: So in my case, I'm using the provide messages, which is yet another way of calling this.
cues.zh: 這裡我覆寫 ProvideMessages，這又是另一種使用方式。

cues.en: So we can go in and say, for example, make all text uppercase.
cues.zh: 例如可以要求：「把所有文字轉成大寫」。

cues.en: So if we do that and say hi, we will now see that we call our first provider,
cues.zh: 執行並說你好後，會看到先呼叫第一個提供者，

cues.en: which is speak like a pirate, second provider, put the robots at the end, our third provider, uppercase everything,
cues.zh: 要求海盜口吻；第二個要求結尾加機器人；第三個則要求全部大寫。

cues.en: and in our case, it is putting in the ones that does things with instructions, and then it's adding one more message here, make all text uppercase.
cues.zh: 這裡先加入修改指示的內容，再另外加上一則「把所有文字轉成大寫」的訊息。

cues.en: I'm a bit surprised that it puts it after the original message, but they must have evaluated that that is best.
cues.zh: 它把額外訊息放在原本訊息後面，讓我有點意外，但團隊應該評估過這樣比較好。

cues.en: If I had made this implementation, just probably put it before, and then so the real user message would be the highlighted one,
cues.zh: 如果是我實作，可能會放在前面，讓真正的使用者訊息更突出，

cues.en: but they have chosen to put it after, and AI can understand it.
cues.zh: 不過他們選擇放後面，而 AI 仍然能理解。

cues.en: The messages comes back to all three providers, and we now get all our instructions put together,
cues.zh: 回覆會交回三個提供者，所有指示也都整合在一起，

cues.en: plus the extra message that gives even further instructions being uppercase.
cues.zh: 再加上要求大寫的那則額外訊息。

cues.en: So now we have three of these, but there's one more way of using the message providers.
cues.zh: 現在有三個提供者；不過 Message Provider 還有另一種使用方式。

cues.en: You can't use these for that for some reason.
cues.zh: 由於某些原因，這種方式不能使用一般的 AI Context Provider。

cues.en: Perhaps that will change, but you can also make this as middleware.
cues.zh: 也許未來會改變；你也可以把它當成中介軟體。

cues.en: So middleware is where we do the tool calling middleware, the OpenTelemetry middleware, but we also have an AI context provider's middleware now.
cues.zh: 中介軟體就是前面設定工具呼叫與 OpenTelemetry 的地方；現在也有 AI Context Provider 的中介軟體。

cues.en: So this one can only take message context providers.
cues.zh: 不過這個方法只能接收 MessageContextProvider。

cues.en: It cannot take my AI context provider.
cues.zh: 無法接收一般的 MyAIContextProvider。

cues.en: It will say it's a wrong type. Okay.
cues.zh: 它會提示型別不正確。

cues.en: So if we do this, things change a bit.
cues.zh: 改成這樣使用時，流程會稍有不同。

cues.en: Let's get rid of... let's keep these two, but keep this one down here.
cues.zh: 先保留前面兩個，把這一個放在下方。

cues.en: Because when they are run like this, and we say hi, we essentially end up with the same scenario,
cues.zh: 再說一次你好，最後結果基本上相同，

cues.en: but we are now calling for the provider.
cues.zh: 不過現在這個提供者的呼叫順序改變了。

cues.en: We can see that happens before everything else.
cues.zh: 可以看到，它會先於其他提供者執行。

cues.en: So it's like this one is going before the ones we get up here.
cues.zh: 也就是下方這個會在上方那些之前執行。

cues.en: And it's also calling another invoking version instead of the context,
cues.zh: 它也會呼叫另一種 Invoking 版本，而不是前面的 context 版本，

cues.en: because we cannot provide context for the myMessage right now.
cues.zh: 因為 MyMessageProvider 在這裡無法提供完整 context。

cues.en: I don't know if it's a bug or if it's a feature, but they have chosen to do that.
cues.zh: 我不確定這是設計還是問題，但團隊目前選擇這樣實作。

cues.en: Them being Microsoft Agent Framework team, of course.
cues.zh: 這裡的團隊，當然是 Microsoft Agent Framework 團隊。

cues.en: The thing is essentially the same. We get the exact same setup.
cues.zh: 本質上，最後得到的設定仍完全相同。

cues.en: But why would we ever want to do it down here?
cues.zh: 那為什麼要放在下方呢？

cues.en: Well, this down here is kind of okay that we can do this, because, for example, if we get an agent that we don't define,
cues.zh: 這個做法其實很有用；例如我們拿到的代理程式不是自己建立的，

cues.en: we don't have the chance to put in AI context providers.
cues.zh: 就沒有機會在建立時加入 AI Context Provider。

cues.en: So, for example, if we use the Google's A2A protocol, the agent-to-agent protocol, we're just being given an agent,
cues.zh: 例如使用 Google 的 A2A，也就是 Agent-to-Agent 協定，只會取得一個代理程式，

cues.en: but we're not being able to give it any kind of options, meaning we're not able to put in our providers.
cues.zh: 卻不能提供建立時的選項，因此無法直接加入自己的提供者。

cues.en: But down here, we can certainly put in providers, but only providers to put in extra messages.
cues.zh: 但在下方仍然可以加入提供者，只是只能注入額外訊息。

cues.en: And that's probably one of the reasons why we don't get the context, because they can't on the fly inject system messages,
cues.zh: 這可能也是拿不到完整 context 的原因之一，因為無法動態調整系統指示，

cues.en: but they can at least send extra messages like this down here.
cues.zh: 但至少可以像這樣送出額外訊息。

cues.en: So, it sort of makes sense that we can't inject instructions down here, but only messages.
cues.zh: 因此，這裡只能加入訊息、不能注入指示，其實有一定道理。

cues.en: But that's the main reason. If you own the agent, you probably don't want to use the middleware parts.
cues.zh: 這就是主要用途。如果代理程式是自己建立的，通常就不需要使用中介軟體版本。

cues.en: You will just put them in as your own providers.
cues.zh: 直接在自己的代理程式選項中加入提供者即可。

cues.en: But in those cases, it's a nice thing that we can actually inject them by just putting in messages, because that is under our control,
cues.zh: 但對剛才那類情況，能透過額外訊息來注入內容，就很有幫助，因為訊息仍由我們控制，

cues.en: no matter how the agent has been created.
cues.zh: 不受代理程式建立方式的限制。

cues.en: So, that is actually everything there is to say about context providers.
cues.zh: 以上就是 Context Provider 的完整介紹。

cues.en: They are kind of intimidating, but end of day, you should just see them as a place to put something in before,
cues.zh: 它們看起來可能有點複雜，但可以把它理解為：在呼叫前加入內容，

cues.en: adjust on the fly instructions and tools, and after the fact, do something.
cues.zh: 動態調整指示與工具，並在呼叫後進行額外處理。

cues.en: So, again, my best two examples is the memory part, where we can on the fly put in memory, and on the fly extract it again,
cues.zh: 我最常用的兩個例子，就是記憶功能：動態加入記憶，再從回覆中擷取記憶，

cues.en: and the tool calling injection, where we can on the fly determine what tools to put in, so we can save tokens not giving every single tool.
cues.zh: 以及工具注入：動態決定要提供哪些工具，避免每次都傳入全部工具而浪費 Token。

cues.en: There's probably many other ways of doing this.
cues.zh: 當然，應該還有許多其他用法。

cues.en: My agent framework themselves have used it to make agent skills.
cues.zh: Microsoft Agent Framework 團隊自己也用它來實作 Agent Skills。

cues.en: I have a different video on that, and I will compare my agent skills to their agent skills,
cues.zh: 我有另一支影片，會比較我自己的 Agent Skills 與官方版本，

cues.en: but they're actually using the AI context providers in order to inject those tools on the fly.
cues.zh: 而官方就是利用 AI Context Provider 動態注入相關工具。

cues.en: Kind of a cool idea, but I find it a little too limiting what they do, but that's for another video.
cues.zh: 這個點子不錯，但我覺得目前的做法限制稍多，那就留到另一支影片再說。

cues.en: So, for now, I know this is a bit advanced, but we needed to go deep dive in order to understand this,
cues.zh: 我知道這次內容比較進階，不過要理解它，確實需要深入說明，

cues.en: and now that it's logged in and not changing a lot, it made sense to do this now.
cues.zh: 而且現在介面已逐漸穩定，不再頻繁變動，正好適合完整介紹。

cues.en: So, thank you for listening. See you in the next one.
cues.zh: 謝謝收看，我們下支影片見。
